summary: Implemented the Jupyter utilities feature. Added monai/utils/jupyter_utils.py with is_jupyter() (detects a ZMQInteractiveShell only if IPython is already loaded) and plot_image_grid() (lazy Matplotlib import, channel-first (H,W)/(C,H,W)/(C,D,H,W) handling, middle-slice default for volumes). Added tests/test_jupyter_utils.py: 12 passed, 1 skipped (the Matplotlib grid test, since matplotlib is not in the shared venv). Not run: flake8 (not installed in venv). Docs and CHANGELOG not updated; module not exported from monai/utils/__init__.py. Nothing committed.
